part.text: The obfuscated helpers are mostly bookkeeping. The core bug is in `fixedpoint_d2string` in src/util.c:3985. Let me compare with the upstream fixed version.

state.title: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/redis/redis/7.0.11/src/util.c (text/plain; charset=utf-8)

part.text: The upstream fix is confirmed: in the fixed version, the zero-fill uses `memset(dst + integer_digits + 1, '0', fractional_digits)` which fills the entire fractional area before digits are written from the right, whereas the testbed version only fills up to `fractional_digits`, leaving uninitialized junk bytes (e.g. `0.00\xfc1` for value `0.0001`). Let me check the existing tests and apply the fix.

part.text: Fixed. The bug was in `fixedpoint_d2string` (src/util.c:4047), used by `addReplyDoubleDistance` for GEORADIUS/GEORADIUSBYMEMBER `WITHDIST` output: the zero-fill loop only ran up to `fractional_digits`, so when the scaled integer had fewer digits than the fractional width (e.g. distance `0.0001` → scaled value `1`), positions before the first digit were left uninitialized, producing mangled output like `0.00\xfc1`. The fix fills the entire fractional area with `memset`, matching upstream. `unit/geo` (including the previously failing `{GEOSEARCH with small distance}` test) and `unit/type/zset` all pass.
